verdict.rationale: Ultrametric ships skill files: `ultrametric init` writes its own SKILL.md into `.agents/skills` and `.claude/skills`, and those files can be committed for team sharing. Because it ships skills, the skill-authoring axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents a template, frontmatter spec (name/description), or guide for authoring a new skill. Installing the vendor's own skill is an adjacent capability, not an authoring template.
